content.definitions: Work in finite-dimensional Euclidean R^d on known nonempty compact convex X, diam(X)<=D, D>0. N_X(y)={n:<n,u-y><=0 for all u in X}. Fixed integer p>=2; known L_p>0; G is C^(p-1) on an open neighborhood, Lip(D^(p-1)G)<=L_p in multilinear operator norm, and mu-strongly monotone on X. No bound on lower derivatives or continuous pth derivative is required. mu,delta>0, w in X, 0<R<=D. zstar is the unique VI solution. The true distance ||w-zstar|| is hidden and analysis-only.
content.interfaces: Q_a=L_p a^p/epsilon; L_A(a,epsilon)=1+log(2+D/a+Q_a). A_{alpha,b}(G,z,a,epsilon), under the promise ||z-zstar||<=a, returns y in X, genuine n in N_X(y), saved evaluated G(y), and ||G(y)+n||<=epsilon within its public fixed cap C_p(1+Q_a^alpha)L_A(a,epsilon)^b. It never accepts unverified output under a false promise. kappa_D=L_p D^(p-1)/mu; L_S(mu,delta)=1+log(2+kappa_D+L_p D^p/delta+mu D/delta). All logarithmic terms are dimensionless. The strong interface S_{gamma,c} is not given r_true=||w-zstar|| and bounds original queries by C_p[1+(L_p r_true^(p-1)/mu)^gamma]L_S^c, using the additive convention at r_true=0. Leading constants are known, fixed and independent of the instance.

limitations.scope: Standalone promised-radius trial and its use within AdaptiveStrong.
limitations.statement: A false supplied radius can cause Failure. Residual-interface certification and interruptible caps are essential; an uncapped promised-distance method is insufficient.

performance_links.scope_note: Performance refers explicitly to AdaptiveStrong(RestartTrial(A_{alpha,b})), yielding S_{alpha,b+2}. It is not the unknown-distance cost of one standalone RestartTrial.

variants.cost: Count every original-F exact-jet query in A and all descendants, including certificate evaluation. Before each such query, charge/decrement EVERY active ancestor counter. A depleted counter immediately aborts its capped call before the next query; failure propagates to this trial. A query of an affine-regularized G derived from F uses one original-F query plus known affine data. Exact known-domain computations are internal. For a valid supplied radius, stage Q_j<=2L_p a_j^(p-1)/mu, a_j=R/2^j; the trial uses the finite sum of prescribed stage caps. The linked unknown-radius rate applies only after AdaptiveStrong wraps this trial.
variants.implementation_details_ref: Original PDF Algorithm 4 p.18; Lemma 5.3 and equation (5.5) p.17; Definition 5.1 p.16.
variants.name: RestartTrial(A,G,w,mu,R,delta)
variants.output: Only a feasible point y, genuine original-domain normal n, saved evaluated G(y), and ||G(y)+n||<=delta; otherwise Failure. Normals always belong to N_X, not to an artificial radius-ball normal cone.
public_inputs: Abstract budget-capped residual implementation A_{alpha,b} and its known constant
variants.query_and_update: Loop: sigma=max(delta,mu a/2). Run capped A(G,z,a,sigma). If it fails or is interrupted, return Failure immediately. Otherwise obtain its verified output (y,n,G(y)). If sigma=delta, return that output. Otherwise set z=y and a=a/2 and repeat.
variants.requirements: Standing definitions and residual interface above. For the Lemma 5.3 performance link, alpha>0 is fixed as in the paper's hierarchy, with its fixed logarithmic exponent b. A and every enclosing capped call must be interruptible.
variants.state_and_initialization: z=w; a=R. R may be an invalid guess; validity is needed only for guaranteed success.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: The final stage is the first j>=0 with mu R/(2^(j+1))<=delta. Thus at most 1+ceil(log_+(mu R/(2delta))/log 2) calls are scheduled, including the final delta call. Stage count is predetermined even if the initial promise is false.
